entry.description: Only deserialize the `ObjectMessage` classes registered through the `org.apache.flume.source.jms.JMSObjectMessageClassProvider` service provider interface. Boxed primitives, `String`, `BigInteger` and `BigDecimal` are allowed by default; all other classes must be registered. If the deserialization filter factory cannot be installed, start the JVM with `-Djdk.serialFilterFactory=org.apache.flume.source.jms.JMSObjectMessageFilter`.
